A [[Codru-Ji]] '''clan''' kidnapped [[Rikkar-Du]] at some point in his life. Rikkar-Du fell in love with [[Tassa]], the daughter of the [[Tassa's father|clan chief]]. Rikkar-Du and Tassa eventually [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and Rikkar-Du and Tassa's clan united.
